settingLabels.tasks.board_card_fields.na: Fields shown on a task board card
settingLabels.tasks.board_card_fields.de: Which fields a card on the task board shows, in order, as a JSON array of field references — for example ["builtin:number","builtin:assignees","custom:region"]. Change it on the Task workflow screen, in the Board card section, which offers the fields that exist; a reference that names no field is skipped, and at most six are shown. One choice for the whole platform.
settingLabels.tasks.time_zone.name: Time zone of task due dates, reminders and the daily digest
settingLabels.tasks.time_zone.descriptio: The time zone, as an IANA name such as Europe/Warsaw, in which Tasks count "today": when a task with a due date but no time becomes overdue, the date a due time falls on, the 09:00 a reminder relative to a date-only due date fires at, and the hour each person's daily digest is sent.
